name: Parapet Thrasher
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever one or more Dragons you control deal combat damage to an opponent, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn —
• Destroy target artifact that opponent controls.
• This creature deals 4 damage to each other opponent.
• Exile the top card of your library. You may play it this turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more Dragons you control deal combat damage to an opponent, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn —

needs.what: choose_mode striking off the modes already chosen THIS TURN ("choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn"), so the spent modes come back at the next turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_mode's once_each records spent modes as permanent flags on the source (cleared only on a zone change), which is Henrika's "hasn't been chosen" for the object's whole life; after Parapet Thrasher's first turn of use the card would run out of modes for ever. The per-opponent trigger half of the line is now expressible: creatures_deal_combat_damage with per_player, defending: opponent, {"binding": "defender"} for "that opponent" and {"not": {"binding": "defender"}, "except": "you"} for "each other opponent"
